Texas Floods Cause Death, Stranding Residents and Disrupting Aid

Central Texas experienced life-threatening flash floods and storms, leading to at least one confirmed death during rescue operations. The severe weather caused significant disruption, including stranded residents unable to access essential services like medicine and requiring aerial rescues. The event occurred approximately one year after a similar disaster at Camp Mystic.
